comparison: NFC plus collapsed whitespace; preserve accents, case, punctuation and fullwidth digits. Original pass only, no fitting or confidence selection.
preprocessing_difference: Official ORT and isolated RTen share exact OpenCV INTER_LINEAR BGR tensors. Actual CLI uses image crate triangle resize; width ceiling, BGR order, normalized zero padding and affine normalization match model contract.
identity_limitation: Canonical Opt identity appears in prior custom Latin V1 training; Japanese crops are transfer/runtime probes, not globally canonical-unseen evidence. Upstream Paddle pretraining prints are unknown. No current model is fine-tuned by this evaluation.
